summary: Iteration 2 backend testing of 3 new feature areas in AI Advocate: (1) Photo evidence analysis via Gemini 2.5 Flash, (2) Location services in user preferences, (3) Law firm directory with filtering, geo-sorting, inquiries (auth) and public advertise application. Extended existing pytest suite with 18 new tests. Full suite 42/42 PASSED in 68.97s.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~804 lines with mixed concerns (auth, lex chat, evidence, lawfirms, subscriptions, voice, contracts). Consider splitting into modules (routers/auth.py, routers/lawfirms.py, routers/evidence.py) once it crosses ~700 lines per code-review guidelines.

/api/lawfirms/advertise (public endpoint) has NO rate limiting / captcha — vulnerable to spam/abuse since anyone can POST applications to law_firm_applications. Recommend rate limit + simple honeypot or captcha before production.
ensure_lawfirm_seed() only seeds when count==0; if SAMPLE_FIRMS list is later updated, existing DB will not get new firms. Consider versioned seeding or upsert-by-name for future expansions.

Evidence analyze endpoint writes uploaded image to a temp file but uses NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False) and unlinks in finally — OK. However on exception before tmp.close() this would leak; current ordering writes->close->try-LLM->finally-unlink, which is safe.

Evidence analyze stores full analysis text in legal_files but does not store the image bytes or any reference (file is deleted). If the user later wants to re-view what was analysed, only the analysis remains. Acceptable for MVP but worth noting.
law_firm_inquiries does not enforce user trial/subscription gating — a user with expired trial can still send inquiries. May or may not be intentional. Worth confirming product intent.

user_to_public exposes latitude/longitude verbatim once set (returned by /auth/me and /auth/preferences). Fine for owner-only endpoints, but ensure no admin/list endpoint ever returns user objects publicly.
haversine_km is defined inline; consider moving to utils. Minor.
test_credentials: Auto-generated per run via /api/auth/signup (test_<rand>@advocate.app / Test12345!). /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty — no static admin/test users defined.
seed_data_creation: ensure_lawfirm_seed() in server.py startup hook seeds 12 SAMPLE_FIRMS across GB,ES,FR,DE,PL,IT,PT,PK,IN,AE,CN with 5 sponsored. Confirmed present and returned by GET /api/lawfirms.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 42 backend tests pass (24 from iter1 + 18 new for iter2). Test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is the regression suite — extend it for new endpoints. The advertise endpoint is intentionally public; do not add auth tests for it. Evidence analyze uses Gemini 2.5 Flash via emergentintegrations and depends on EMERGENT_LLM_KEY having credit. The PIL-generated test JPEG is enough to satisfy validation; analysis returns >50 chars. Frontend not yet tested for these features.
